authorization.statement: User-supplied statement: the video was copied from a user-authorized source to demo/cam01.mp4 for this CCTV project.
authorization.statement_basis: Supplied by the user in the task instructions

visual_assessment.inspection_basis: Six time-spread full-frame JPEGs and their labeled contact sheet were visually inspected.
visual_assessment.scene: A densely occupied outdoor pedestrian area with unpaved, rough ground in bright, hazy daylight.
visual_assessment.camera_angle: Elevated, oblique downward-looking view. No obvious large viewpoint change is visible across the six samples; camera intrinsics and extrinsics are unknown.
visual_assessment.crowd_and_occlusion: Dense crowding is visible in every inspected sample, with frequent person-to-person occlusion, partially visible bodies, and people cropped by image boundaries. No numerical crowd count was produced.
visual_assessment.motion: People change positions across the time-spread samples and show varied orientations and close interactions. Motion was not manually annotated frame by frame, and no track ground truth was produced.

known_positive_person_detection_smoke_te.scope: The clip can verify that a person detector produces some detections on known-positive footage. It is not, by itself, a detection-accuracy or tracking benchmark.

entrance_validation.reason: No bounded doorway, gate, entrance threshold, or unambiguous entry/exit crossing zone is visible in the inspected samples.

queue_validation.reason: The crowd is dense, but no stable ordered queue and associated service point can be reliably established from the inspected samples.

stair_validation.reason: No staircase, stair landing, or vertical circulation transition is visible in the inspected samples.

validation_scope_and_limitations: Single 23.690333-second clip from one uncalibrated view; no multi-camera, overlap, or floor-transition validation is claimed.
Visual assessment is based on representative samples, not exhaustive annotation of every frame.
No ground-truth person counts, identities, tracks, entrance events, queue metrics, or stair events were created or inferred.
No person identification or sensitive-trait inference was performed.
Calibration remains MISSING; geometry-dependent validation is not supported.
A clean OpenCV sequential decode is not a formal compressed-bitstream conformance audit.
